§bLarge Naquadah Annihilation Field Reactor§r

A large generator driven by liquid nuclear or naquadah fuel.

Work efficiency rises 1% per 30 seconds of running, up to 400%, which stretches each fuel's burn time. Force Field Restriction Coils (tier I-IV) multiply output x1 to x4. Optional coolants (IC2 Coolant up to Tachyon-Rich Temporal Fluid) and excited fluids (Caesium up to Expanded Space Fluid) raise output further.

With no dynamo hatch it feeds the wireless network directly.

Check the recipe and structure preview in NEI for your installed MessTech version.

§aTask§r: have one in your inventory. It is not consumed.
